h: Timaya's private jet photos with Joy Adesanya spark dating rumours
p: Singer Timaya has set fans talking after posting private jet photos with a woman identified as Joy Adesanya, with a playful caption about a 'secret battle'. Neither has confirmed a relationship.
body: Singer Timaya has sparked dating rumours after sharing photos with a woman identified as Joy Adesanya.

On Tuesday, 10 November 2026, Timaya posted a series of photos on Instagram showing himself and Joy Adesanya on board a private jet. His caption, framed as a confession about a long-running personal 'secret battle', ended with a playful punchline rather than any explanation, which only fuelled curiosity about the pair.
Neither Timaya nor Joy Adesanya has confirmed or denied any romantic relationship.

Timaya, whose real name is Inetimi Odon, is one of Nigeria's best-known dancehall artists and the founder of DM Records. He is known for hits such as 'Plantain Boy' and 'Bum Bum'. He was seen talking with Burna Boy at an event last week, in a video that went viral for other reasons.
more: Timaya posted jet photos with Joy Adesanya.
